name: Linear Algebra Projection Dimension
description: Transforms the graph connectivity requirement into a condition on the dimension of the projection of a solution space. Instead of asking for $t$ parameters to be equal, it asks to select a system of equations $x_u = x_v$ such that the projection of the solution space onto the $t$ target axes has a dimension of exactly 1. This hides the graph connectivity and Steiner Tree structure behind rigorous linear algebra concepts, forcing the model to mathematically deduce that "projection dimension = 1" is a bijection to "all $t$ target variables are in the same connected component".
